events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' was released 58 years ago today in 1968.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' on the world. What's your favourite track from this sprawling masterpiece?

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Tribute to a Legend
angles.copy: Remembering the extraordinary Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His voice, stage presence, and legacy remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released 61 years ago today in 1965.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years of 'Rubber Soul'. The album that marked a pivotal shift for The Beatles. Which track still resonates with you?

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on. His music and message continue to inspire generations. Imagine that.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Music icon David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering Bowie
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. Remembering David Bowie's incredible artistry and enduring impact on music and culture.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: The King's Birthday
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. His music is still shaking up the airwaves.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitar legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, a true architect of rock.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic British singer Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rock & Roll Heart
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Rod Stewart! Still rocking and still got that distinctive voice.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Legend
angles.copy: One step beyond and 66 years young! Happy birthday to the brilliant Suggs, frontman of Madness.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Wherever He Lays His Hat
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young! Still loving the common people, and his timeless hits.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Country music legend Dolly Parton would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Dolly Parton, who would have been 81 today. Her legacy shines bright like a rhinestone.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That's Main Man
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That's biggest hits to his solo career, a true British music icon.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Get outta our dreams and into the birthday celebrations! Happy 77th to the legendary Billy Ocean.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's 38th anniversary
events.blurb: The first-ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held 38 years ago today in 1989.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: 38 years since the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame first opened its doors. Who were the inaugural inductees, and who do you think should be next?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still bringing the pop magic after all these years.

events.title: Beatles rooftop concert 58th anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their famous impromptu rooftop concert on the Apple Corps building 58 years ago today in 1969.

angles.name: Legendary Rooftop Gig
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles took to the roof for their iconic last public performance. An unforgettable moment in music history.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: British singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! From Genesis to solo stardom, a true musical powerhouse.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American pop superstar and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Prince of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From 'N Sync to solo hits, he's still bringing SexyBack.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! From Del Boy to Jack Frost, a true TV legend.

events.title: 68 years since The Day The Music Died
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash in 1959, a day famously known as 'The Day The Music Died'.

angles.name: Music Never Dies
angles.copy: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died'. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to Rick Astley! Still never gonna give you up, never gonna let you down.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: One love, one heart. Bob Marley would have been 82 today. His message of peace and unity resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary American singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Tapestry of Talent
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! A songwriting genius whose 'Tapestry' still weaves magic.

events.title: 15 years since Whitney Houston's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 15 years since the world lost the iconic voice of Whitney Houston, who would have been 64 this year.

angles.name: The Voice Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Whitney Houston, 15 years since her passing. Her voice truly was the greatest love of all.

events.title: 31st anniversary of Take That's original split
events.blurb: Today marks 31 years since Take That originally announced their split in 1996, breaking millions of hearts across the nation.

angles.name: Never Forget
angles.copy: Remembering the day hearts broke across the UK: 31 years since Take That's original split. Thankfully, they came back for good!
